verdict.rationale: Google Workspace includes an AI assistant (Gemini in Gmail), so letting users plug in MCP servers as tool sources is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP client support or connecting external MCP servers. Marketplace app integrations and Apps Script automation are adjacent features, not MCP tool plug-in.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
